properties.site-address: West Orchard House, Allendale Road, Hexham (brownfield parcel)
properties.notes: Potential redevelopment of office buildings and land within the existing urban environment. Largely brownfield site with small element of greenfield land. The overall SHLAA site is mixed but a reduced yield recognises a focus on the brownfield land (0.24ha) . Brownfield element considered to be suitable for small-scale development of 6 units. Application for a single dwelling has been permitted (15/03735/FUL) but it is considered that further potential may remain for the land. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 2554) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.43ha
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
